description: `GET /v1/files/{file_id}/content` answers 200 with the raw bytes as `application/octet-stream`, but the spec types that body as `{ "type": "string" }` without `format: binary`, so the converter drops it and the operation returns nothing. The official SDKs read this response as binary (`__binaryResponse: true` in anthropics/anthropic-sdk-typescript). Model the body as a raw `Blob` payload so the call returns the bytes as a `Uint8Array`.
